title: EU Approves €115 Million Emergency Aid Package for Spain Over Ceuta Crisis
detail: The European Union has formally approved €115 million in emergency aid for Spain to address the ongoing Ceuta border migration crisis, marking the EU's first major financial commitment to the situation. The package follows the European Commission's technical mission dispatch after an earlier Marlaska-Brunner call on EU support.

title: Ceuta President Vivas Urges EU to Take Firm Action Against Morocco
detail: Ceuta president Juan Jesús Vivas said the exclave is 'on the brink of collapse' and accused Morocco of pursuing a 'policy of harassment' against the city, urging the EU to make clear that fruitful cooperation with Rabat 'begins by respecting our borders.' Vivas distanced himself from Madrid's characterization of Morocco as a 'trusted partner,' noting the European Commission is financing Morocco's migration management strategy with €160 million through 2027.

media.caption: Ceuta president Juan Jesús Vivas says the city is 'on the brink of collapse'
